artifacts.name: BRIDGE for Windows
releaseNotes: All 11 Windows .NET 8 core/security/networking/streaming modules compiled cleanly (0 errors) and Bridge.Tests passed 3/3 xUnit tests.
Final WinUI 3 XAML compilation (XamlCompiler.exe) and WiX v4 MSI packaging require a Windows host (windows-latest).
artifacts.buildEnvironmentNote: Blocked on Linux container by Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK XamlCompiler.exe (Win32 binary). Run .github/workflows/build-windows.yml on windows-latest or build-windows.ps1 on Windows.

artifacts.name: BRIDGE for Android
releaseNotes: Compiled with Gradle 8.9 and Android SDK 35 (compileSdk 35, minSdk 29).
Passed testDebugUnitTest (3/3 JUnit tests) and verified with apksigner (APK Signature Scheme v2).
artifacts.buildEnvironmentNote: Real installable APK compiled and verified on disk; signed with Android debug keystore for direct sideload installation (no production secrets committed).

artifacts.name: BRIDGE Protocol v1.0 Specification
releaseNotes: Canonical versioned envelope schema and 23 message types used by Windows, Android, and automated protocol validation.
artifacts.buildEnvironmentNote: Verified directly from repository disk with live SHA-256 checksum.
